description.zh: 更改集ID。如果不需要更改集详细信息，可使用此参数代替GetChangeSet接口。
description.en: The change set ID. If you do not need detailed information about the change set, you can use this parameter instead of calling the GetChangeSet operation.

description.zh: 更改集的名称。N的最大值为5。支持使用通配符星号（*）进行模糊搜索。
description.en: The name of the change set. Maximum value of N: 5. You can use the wildcard character asterisk (\*) for fuzzy match.

description.zh:
更改集的执行状态。N的最大值为5。取值：
- UNAVAILABLE
- AVAILABLE
- EXECUTE_IN_PROGRESS
- EXECUTE_COMPLETE
- EXECUTE_FAILED
- OBSOLETE
description.en:
The execution status of the change set. Maximum value of N: 5. Valid values:
- UNAVAILABLE
- AVAILABLE
- EXECUTE_IN_PROGRESS
- EXECUTE_COMPLETE
- EXECUTE_FAILED
- OBSOLETE.

description.zh:
更改集列表的页码。  
起始值：1。  
默认值：1。
description.en:
The page number of the change set list.  
Minimum value: 1.  
Default value: 1.

description.zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。必须为整数。
取值范围：1~50。
默认值：10。
description.en:
The number of entries per page in paging query. The value must be an integer.
Valid values: 1 to 50.
Default value: 10.

description.zh: 更改集所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~131035~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the change set. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~131035~~) to query the most recent region list.

description.zh:
更改集的状态。N的最大值为5。取值：
- CREATE_PENDING
- CREATE_IN_PROGRESS
- CREATE_COMPLETE
- CREATE_FAILED
- DELETE_FAILED
- DELETE_COMPLETE
description.en:
The status of the change set. Maximum value of N: 5. Valid values:
- CREATE_PENDING
- CREATE_IN_PROGRESS
- CREATE_COMPLETE
- CREATE_FAILED
- DELETE_FAILED
- DELETE_COMPLETE.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ros list-change-sets --stack-id 4a6c9851-3b0f-4f5f-b4ca-a14bf6910000 --page-size 10 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --change-set-id 1f6521a4-05af-4975-afe9-bc4b45ad0000 --status CREATE_COMPLETE --change-set-name MyChangeSet --execution-status AVAILABLE --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ros ListChangeSets --region cn-hangzhou --Status.1 CREATE_COMPLETE --ChangeSetId '1f6521a4-05af-4975-afe9-bc4b45ad0000' --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ChangeSetName.1 MyChangeSet --ExecutionStatus.1 AVAILABLE --StackId '4a6c9851-3b0f-4f5f-b4ca-a14bf6910000'
